name: Worst Day Of Your Life So Far
look: Two stacked panels from The Simpsons on a street corner under a pink sunset sky. Top: Bart stands alone with a pained, uneasy grimace. Bottom: Homer crouches beside him, grinning and pressing a finger to Bart's chest while Bart looks up at him.
use: The top panel is Bart's complaint that something is the worst it has ever been. The bottom is Homer's cheerful reply that it's only the worst so far, a joke that things are going to get even worse.
slots: top panel: Bart's complaint that something is the worst
bottom panel: Homer's reply that it's only the worst so far
examples: This is the worst traffic I've ever been in
This is the ugliest code I've ever seen
The ugliest code you've seen so far
describe: bart looks miserable and then homer pokes him in the chest
homer crouching and pointing at bart with a big grin
simpsons dad cheerfully telling his son it will get worse
bart grimacing on the sidewalk at sunset
homer grinning at bart because things will only get worse
origin: Bart complains it's the worst day of his life and Homer cheerfully replies that it's only the worst so far.
